observations.title: Inspect decorative tooltips and gear models
observations.player_action: Hover supported armor, tools or weapons in an inventory.
observations.outcome: The tooltip can show animated frames/particles and integrated 3D item previews.
conditions: External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
